capabilities: Mirror a Zotero library as markdown files in a vault folder
Sync and cache Zotero data incrementally via the Zotero web API
Optionally sync through a locally installed Zotero app
Customize generated note templates with item, collection and library data
disambiguation: Despite the name, the sync is one-way and read-only; edits to the generated markdown files are never written back to Zotero.
extras: The plugin is desktop-only; generated markdown files then reach mobile clients through ordinary vault sync. Initial synchronization may take a while and is designed to minimize API usage.
intentEvidence: Check out the following alternatives if you are interested in: - Taking notes directly within Zotero
motivation: The author wanted seamless Zotero integration via note linking and search while keeping all literature data within Zotero.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to link to and search the contents of a Zotero reference library from within the vault.

relations.evidence: Taking notes directly within Zotero (with two-way sync to Obsidian): Zotero Better Notes
Importing citations on-demand into Obsidian: Obsidian Zotero Integration or Obsidian Citation Plugin
Importing citations on-demand into Obsidian: Obsidian Zotero Integration or Obsidian Citation Plugin
Integrating with Zotero via the ZotServer API: Zotero Bridge
This plugin uses the excellent retorquere/zotero-sync package for the Zotero API integration.

summary: Zotero API client that mirrors a Zotero library into the vault as read-only markdown notes, synced from the web API or a local Zotero app.
